confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Riviera Maya pricing, not checked against live listings or venue menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel anchors vary most by season and property. The FX observation comes from a search summary that cites the RBA exchange rates overview page; I did not open the RBA F11.1 table to verify it directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the Riviera Maya / northern Quintana Roo coastal resort market, with Cancun and Tulum as the closest comparables. Prices are set below resort-zone and hotel-bar levels to reflect ordinary local venues, with accommodation set toward the mid-range of that market for July.
